meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按发布流程把 oh-my-opencode 等包发到 npm:触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,并验证 GitHub release、发布说明、Discord 公告和 npm 版本。它只负责发布,不会重新审查已合并的代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“publish”、“release”等关键词,或要求 npm 发布时接管。必须给出 patch、minor、major 或明确的语义化版本号,没给就先停下来问你要哪一个。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流

say.text: 把这个版本发布成 minor
say.note: 按 minor 递增发布并做验证
按你给的语义化版本号发布

howto.what_en: Triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, ships oh-my-opencode and related packages to npm, then verifies the release: GitHub release, release summary, Discord post, npm version. Ship-only; it does not re-review merged code.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention publish, release, or npm publish. It requires a selector: patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver; without one it stops and asks which bump you want.

say_en.note: Triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow
Publishes with a minor bump, then verifies
